title: A Semester for the Playlist
author: Quentin Blackwood
blurb: Gideon Marchetti, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
